assumptions: `first` and `second` are never assigned by any item in the graph (the only two items are item1 and item0, and item1 has no script statements other than the action call). They are therefore passed to `test` as undefined. I am treating this as the workflow's actual behaviour, not as a reading error — if the converted version requires two real numbers, that is a behaviour change.
`System.getModule("...").test(...)` is vRO's standard synchronous action invocation; it blocks the workflow token until the action completes. Modelled as a plain blocking function call.

vRO type `ActionResult` is the generic container vRO uses when an action's return type is not statically narrowed; I am treating `actionResult` as "whatever test returns, untyped" rather than assuming a specific shape.

There is exactly one action invocation in this workflow.
